rows.grounds: instrumental of the compound expressing the sole means
optative expressing injunction governing the accusative object

items.question: By what means alone should one resort to brahman-initiation?
items.inference: Brahman-initiation is to be sought solely through the guru's compassion.
uncertainties: compound internal sandhi not split in the row
items.plain_english: By the guru's compassion alone, one should resort to brahman-initiation.
